verses.text: Ach in Diosal, ul kolineli. Mamin Jehová, kotanh elanhchamel yik tzin a kolani.
Ha heb' snib'an in smilanchamok, k'ixwokab' el heb', somchajokab' el heb'. Ha heb' snib'ej yak'an chukal t'ayin, b'atokab' heb' elelal yuj k'ixwelal.
Ha heb' tzin b'uchani, haton heb' tz'el stzub' t'ayin, b'atokab' heb' elelal yuj k'ixwelal.
Haxo masanil heb' syak'em sb'a t'ayach, tzalajokab' sk'ol heb'. Ha heb' snib'an a kolwal, yalokab' heb' to te niwan elk'ochi.
Ha in pax tik jun, ilb'aj in k'o'ol, kusk'olal waji. Haxo swalani: Ach in Diosal, kotanh t'a elanhchamel yik tzin a kolani. Ha achnhej tzin a koltaxoni. Kotanh t'a elanhchamel, Mamin Jehová, xin chi.
